title: pwmd: exit on unrecoverable protocol blockers for node role (not passive seal wait)
brief: Owner/design: if insurmountable protocol preconditions prevent the node's role (e.g. proposer with empty active validator set at height 1), pwmd must exit with clear ERROR — not idle in seal loop with cluster_primary_wait forever. Context: V6-3 stake admission + default genesis without min_validator_stake:0 caused passive stall; snapshot path already exits (unless --keep-alive-on-snapshot-error).
acceptance_criteria: Proposer/sealer: unrecoverable proposer_pick_failed (no active validators) at startup or first seal attempt → process exit non-zero + actionable log (genesis min_validator_stake / stake)
Attester standby: unchanged unless same blocker applies to its role
Existing --keep-alive-on-snapshot-error semantics preserved; no silent regression for recoverable failover windows
Unit or lifecycle test for empty active set fail-fast path

delegations.prompt_summary: Fail-fast on empty active validator set for sealing proposer
delegations.notes: Added startup fatal blocker detection for proposer pick errors (`no active validators for current epoch`), exits with actionable ERROR, and lifecycle unit coverage for fatal/non-fatal paths.

notes: Operator interim fix remains min_validator_stake:0 in lab genesis. This slice is UX/safety: misconfig should fail loud.
